subject: english
title: Sentence Polishing · Q2 W04 D04
objective: Use a capital letter and correct end punctuation in a simple sentence.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ Begin a sentence with a capital letter. Use a period, question mark, or exclamation mark that matches the meaning. Ready to explore? Try the skill with a classmate's name. Try the skill with a sentence about a helpful neighbor. Try the skill with a question during reading time.

vocabulary.definition: A telling sentence that gives information and ends with a period.
A question sentence that ends with a question mark.
An exclamation sentence that ends with an exclamation mark.
